name: Render's Valley
summary: Blackrock orcs hold a small camp in the southeastern Redridge Mountains at Render's Valley. It threatens nearby travelers and keeps captives taken from surrounding lands.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Southeast
sections.body: Render's Valley lies among rocky ridges southeast of Lake Everstill, where Blackrock orcs keep an auxiliary camp for their operations in Redridge. Unlike the fortified keeps and stone towers on the northern cliffs, this camp gathers around war tents, banners, and sentry posts. Its warriors are smaller in number and less armed than the clan's core forces, but they still raid local roads and harass travelers. Captured prisoners remain in crude cages under guard.

sections.title: Secret Paths and Captives
sections.body: Scouts who reach Render's Valley find unexpected points of interest beyond the war parties roaming its dirt paths. Human prisoners have been seen in the camp, including a servant connected to the Tower of Azora who traded specialist goods under his captors' noses. Unmarked paths cross the high southern bluffs behind the valley, letting daring travelers slip into the murky bogs of the Swamp of Sorrows.

aliases: what clan is in renders valley
faq.answer: The aggressive Blackrock clan occupies Render's Valley. Its orcs have pushed south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge to conquer territory and harass human settlements.

faq.q: Are the orcs here as dangerous as the ones at Stonewatch?
aliases: how strong are the orcs here
faq.answer: No. The Blackrock warriors in Render's Valley are generally younger or less formidable skirmishers than the hardened elite forces at Stonewatch Keep to the north.

faq.q: Who is the prisoner kept in the camp?
faq.answer: A servant affiliated with the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest is held in a cage after being captured by the Blackrock clan. Those who reach him can acquire specialized tailoring supplies.

faq.q: Can you reach the Swamp of Sorrows from here?
faq.answer: Yes. An unofficial mountain trail crosses the southern bluffs just past Render's Valley and leads into the northern marches of the Swamp of Sorrows.

angles.text: Render's Valley is a secondary Blackrock raiding outpost threatening southern Redridge. Clearing it helps secure trade and travel in Lakeshire.
The Captured Servant of Azora offers unique tailoring patterns and materials. Craftsmen must fight through the sentries to reach him.
